title: Pope Leo hit by flying rosary while waving to crowds in Peru
summary: The pontiff was struck in the face by what is thought to be prayer beads while travelling aboard the popemobile to deliver a farewell Mass.

blocks.text: Pope Leo XIV was struck in the face by what is thought to be rosary prayer beads while travelling in the popemobile to deliver a farewell Mass in Peru.
Photos and video show the pope rubbing his eye shortly after the object was tossed toward him. He sustained no injuries and the Mass went ahead.
